definition_quote.value: Practicing dentistry means an activity in which a person: (A) undertakes by any means or method to diagnose or profess to diagnose or to treat or profess to treat or to prescribe for or profess to prescribe for any lesions, diseases, disorders, for deficiencies of the human oral cavity, teeth, gingiva, maxilla, or mandible or adjacent associated structures; (B) extracts human teeth or corrects malpositions of the teeth or jaws; (C) furnishes, supplies, constructs, reproduces, or repairs prosthetic dentures, bridges, appliances, or other structures to be used or worn as substitutes for natural teeth or adjusts those structures...; (D) administers general dental anesthetics; (E) administers local dental anesthetics...; or (F) engages in any of the practices included in the curricula of recognized dental colleges.
definition_quote.quote: "Practicing dentistry" means an activity in which a person: (A) undertakes by any means or method to diagnose or profess to diagnose or to treat or profess to treat or to prescribe for or profess to prescribe for any lesions, diseases, disorders, for deficiencies of the human oral cavity, teeth, gingiva, maxilla, or mandible or adjacent associated structures

specialty_advertising_disclaimer_require.quote: holding out to the public as being specially qualified or announcing specialization in any branch of dentistry by using terms such as "specialist in" or "practice limited to" unless: (A) the American Dental Association has formally recognized the specialty and an appropriate certifying board for the specialty; (B) the dentist has met the educational requirements and standards set forth by the Commission on Dental Accreditation for the specialty; or (C) the dentist is a diplomate of the specialty certifying board recognized by the American Dental Association.

dental_hygienist_supervision_levels.quote: "Direct supervision" means supervision by a licensed dentist who is readily available at the dental facility for consultation or intervention. collaborative_agreement_max_hygienists_p.quote: A supervising dentist is limited to entering into a collaborative agreement with no more than two dental therapists at any one time.

dental_office_ownership_restrictions.quote: A dental practice may be owned and operated by the following individuals or entities, either alone or in a combination thereof: (1) a dentist licensed under the provisions of this chapter; (2) a health department or clinic of this State or of a local government agency; (3) a federally qualified health center or community health center designated by the U.S. Department of Health and Human Services to provide dental services; (4) a 501(c)(3) nonprofit or charitable dental organization; (5) a hospital licensed under the laws of this State; (6) an institution or program accredited by the Commission on Dental Accreditation of the American Dental Association
